title: Command Center Documentation
description: Documentation contract for Command Center, the Director Swarm instrument.

contract.extensionRule: Every durable scenario document should be registered here. Use docs/concepts/ for product and system concepts, docs/guides/ for task procedures, docs/reference/ for stable lookup material, docs/internal/ for developer and agent memory, docs/operations/ for runtime operations, and docs/business/ for commercial strategy.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.description: Scenario identity, reading order, and local startup
sections.purpose: Help operators, developers and agents understand what this scenario is, what it must not do, and where to begin.
sections.extensionPolicy: Entrypoint-level documents only. Procedures belong in guides; durable concepts belong in concepts.

documents.title: Start Here
documents.description: What this scenario is, the reading order for its concept documents, and the three things most likely to be got wrong.

documents.title: README
documents.description: Short public-facing description and quick start.

documents.title: Product Requirements Document
documents.description: Operational targets. Static after generation; checkboxes auto-update from requirements sync.

documents.title: Vrooli Command Display
documents.description: The fullscreen command-display design contract governing every visual surface in this scenario.

sections.title: Concepts
sections.description: The instrument contract, the honesty model, and the derivation rules
sections.purpose: Define what the scenario measures, how it qualifies what it measures, and how its shape is derived rather than authored.
sections.extensionPolicy: Durable models only. A document here should still be true after an implementation rewrite.

documents.title: Instrument Model
documents.description: What this scenario is as an instrument: the declared deviation it closes, the six invariants, the production-ledger archetype, and the degradation contract.

documents.title: Coverage Model
documents.description: The two independent honesty axes, their closed vocabularies, denominator-confidence, and the source-team maturity axis.

documents.title: Provenance Model
documents.description: How a reading's honesty is rendered: the four inks, why material rather than colour, and the authored-sample rules.

documents.title: Outcome Taxonomy
documents.description: Why the rooms are the team's outcome categories, how the board derives its own shape, and the rules that keep the taxonomy migratable.

documents.title: Source Map
documents.description: The fleet's declared instruments, what each room inherits from its sources, and the rules for reading a source.

documents.title: Data
documents.description: Storage posture, the outcome registry, a reading on the wire, the board shape, and the setpoint.

documents.title: Architecture
documents.description: The derivation, join and compose layers, the API surfaces, the source-client contract, and what is deliberately absent.

documents.title: UI Architecture
documents.description: The board's layer model, quiet zones, capability ladder, orientation, input vocabulary, motion registers, theming, and component library plan.

sections.title: Reference
sections.description: Stable lookup material for the read surfaces
sections.purpose: Give an agent or operator the exact shape of every surface without reading the implementation.
sections.extensionPolicy: Lookup material only. Rationale belongs in concepts.

documents.title: API Endpoints
documents.description: Every read surface, its shape, the compatibility aliases, and the error and degradation posture.

documents.title: CLI Commands
documents.description: The read verbs that make this instrument readable programmatically, and the output contract.

sections.title: Internal
sections.purpose: Record why the design is what it is, where the code diverges from it, and what changed when.
sections.extensionPolicy: Append-only in spirit. A decision is superseded by a new entry, never edited away.

documents.title: Decisions
documents.description: Binding decisions, newest first, each with its rationale and rejected alternatives.

documents.title: Problems
documents.description: Known defects, the dated divergence between the code and the design contract, upstream blockers, and component library defects found while designing.

documents.title: Progress Log
documents.description: Rolling log of material changes, newest first.
